title: Host Discovery: Three Scenarios
description: Three scenarios showing what happens during host discovery depending on how the network is configured. Scenario 1: ICMP works normally. Scenario 2: A firewall blocks ICMP — the host looks offline but is not. Scenario 3: A TCP probe reveals the hidden host.

nodes.detail: Any TCP response confirms host is alive

caption:
Scenario 1: ICMP Echo Request reaches a live host, which returns an Echo Reply. Host confirmed alive.

Scenario 2: Firewall blocks the ICMP packet silently. The host receives nothing, sends nothing. Ping times out. The host appears offline — it is not.

Scenario 3: A TCP probe is sent to port 80. Firewalls cannot block TCP/80 without breaking web access for every user — so the probe gets through. The host responds with a TCP reply. Either way: the host that was invisible to ICMP is revealed. (The specific names of these TCP responses are covered in the TCP Discovery section.)
